pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to existing positions unless initial trade is in floating profit of at least +1.5x ATR and stop-loss is locked at breakeven+.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum structural stop distance of 25 pips ($2.50 Gold price delta) to prevent spread-wipeouts, backed by a minimum projected 1:3 R:R setup.
profit_harvest_threshold: Activate dynamic trailing lock-in only after floating profit exceeds +$5.00, allowing core position to target $15-$30 expansions.
